All your AI sessions in one window, with the cost in view.

Capy keeps your Claude Code, Codex and Gemini sessions together on your PC. It keeps API and plan accounts apart, checks every file write before it happens, shows what your key spends and writes the end-of-session note for you.

Beta, controlled testVersion 1.28.0Last release 2026-10-24WIP12 in progressSource: Registry, read from the tool's own version file

In numbers

84%cheaper to draft from a written noteA measured draft went from $0.061 to $0.010 when drafts moved to a smaller model. Summaries and wrap-up notes stay on the larger one.
5unsafe actions blocked before any writeA key or token written into a file, code fetched and run at once, TLS turned off, a changed execution policy and the deletion of a whole home folder.
2accounts that never mixAPI runs on your company key, Plan on your own subscription. Capy refuses a Plan message in a work folder or one that mentions work.

On screen

How it works

From a first message to a clean next session.

Capy follows the life of a conversation, not only its start.

Start

Begin from a template or a blank chat. Pick the tool and the folder first. The AI reads the folder and changes nothing until you allow it.

Work

Turn on Can change files and every write is checked first. A command, such as the tests, shows with Allow and Don't allow and runs only after you click. Undo this reply puts back what a Claude Code reply changed. Review changes shows each file as a line diff: comment on any change and send all comments in one message, or put one change back.

Wrap up

Writes an end-of-session note: what happened, the decisions and the next steps, saved in your own vault. You can close the window while it is written.

Continue clean

Starts a new conversation that carries only the note. The old messages stay in the old session, and replies cost less and stay on track.

What leaves this computer

The app lists it in Help. The short version:

WhatWhere it goes
API messagesThe company AI gateway, with your key. Keys and passwords in a message are removed first.
Plan messagesYour own account. They never carry work data.
Team knowledge search, when onThe first 300 characters of an API message, with your own sign-in.
Data catalog lookupTable names and searches. Nothing is changed there.
Once an hourYour name and your Capy version, so the team knows who needs an update. You can turn it off.
Only when you press a buttonFeedback, Register in Knowledge and Hand over.
Stays on the PCYour key (encrypted), attachments and Undo copies (7 days) and your sessions.

Where it stops

Know these before you rely on it.

Windows only

It is a Windows desktop app with a local server.

Work needs a company key

API sessions run on the company AI key. Plan sessions need your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription or a local model.

Undo covers Claude Code replies

Undo this reply restores the files a Claude Code reply changed, from copies kept for 7 days.

Attachments are limited

Up to 5 files per message, and only documents in Work.

It sees this computer only

Capy shows the sessions on this PC. Details opens the folder that holds a session's files.

How the numbers were measured

Every number comes from the product's own change log and help page. The screens are captured from a development copy started with an empty data folder on a spare port, so no session or setting of a real user appears.

Facts come from the product README and docs.
